text:
sara: heads-up: kicking off a small thermal-slice deploy for engine-kernel v2.9.1-quant (PTQ4) starting in +30m. canary slice = 0.5% traffic, 6 pods across eu-west1.

deploybot: scheduled deploy started by sara at 3779998888. plan: staged drain -> canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m hold windows. rollback TTL = 30m sticky-pin enabled.

devon: thanks — what are the rollback triggers this time? last time p99 jitter spiked and we had to pin.

sara: rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.5% for 3m OR p99 latency increase > 30% baseline for 5m OR memory OOM rate >0.2% across canary nodes. also if KV cache hit drops >10%.

mike: add thermal/telemetry: if GPU die temp median raises >5C vs baseline for two consecutive samples -> abort. we're testing a new NVLink lane scheduler, so watch thermal and lane errors.

lee: release notes draft posted in #eng-releases. important callouts: PTQ4 quant artifacts, potential ~4-6% perf variance on long seqs (>8192), and no change to model weights. include recommended fallback: engine-v2.9.1-fp16 (compatible) if we see quality regressions.

devon: can we pin region fallback? prefer eu fallback to dedicated older engine image rather than global rollback to avoid cross-region cascades.

sara: yes — routing policy will prefer regional fallback to engine-v2.8.7 for eu-west1 only. global rollback only if >50% regions report the trigger.

opsbot: smoke check complete on staging at 3779998889: all healthchecks ok, kvcache hit 98.7%, p95 42ms.

deploybot: canary slice deployed to 6 pods at 3779998895. telemetry hooks: /telemetry/engine/v2.9.1/stream enabled. alerting channel: #eng-runtime-alerts.

mike: FYI, we added a temporary flag in the runtime to cap continuous batching at 2 for the canary to mitigate token-latency regressions. will be toggled off at 10% if metrics look good.

devon: tagging metrics to watch: p50/p95/p99, error_rate, kvcache_hit, batch_size_mean, gpu_temp_median, nvlink_errs, client_rtts.

lee: docs/notes: remind support team about client-level fallback: SDKs should handle 429/503 with exponential backoff + fallback header X-Engine-Fallback. put script in release notes so SRE can run the quick pin.

sara: agreed. escalation: if rollback needed, we do sticky-pin of engine-v2.8.7 in eu-west1 for 2 hours, then start a canary of patched build. if emergency rollback global, notify on-call and secops.

mike: minor ask — let's capture a binary checksum at preflight: `sha256sum engine-kernel-v2.9.1.tar.gz` and write to artifact store. if mismatch anywhere we abort.

opsbot: preflight checksum: 9f8c7e6b3a4d2c1e0f9a8b7c6d5e4f3a2b1c0d9e recorded at 3779998898.

deploybot: canary telemetry streaming now. first 2m window starts.

devon: I'll watch alerts for the next 20m. ping me @here if any of the rollback conditions hit.

sara: thanks team — post-deploy checklist: 1) confirm no quality regressions via eval harness 2) check billing/throughput 3) update release notes with final perf numbers. I'll post the final go/no-go in this thread.

lee: noted. adding support playbook link: https://wiki.internal/release_playbooks/engine-v2.9

mike: if we see a slow leak in kvcache, we should reduce max_cached_prefixes to 64 as a hot-fix while we debug.

devon: 2m: no alerts, p95 stable, kvcache hit steady. good so far :thumbsup:

sara: good. leave canary open for 28 more minutes, then advance to 10% if still clean. will update timeline here.

deploybot: staging -> canary -> progression timer set. next step at 3779999060.
